svg.title: TheGeekDogs
svg.desc: DESIGN.md B.12. Not a logo and never rendered on a page: the empty chair's lamp cone, flat lamp amber on flat floor petrol, light values hard-coded. No gradient (a two-stop gradient across 16 physical pixels is a smear), no corner radius (iOS and Android mask the tile themselves) and no prefers-color-scheme block (the tile is dark in both schemes, and a media query here would leave the vector and the three PNGs disagreeing). scripts/build-icons.mjs exports the PNGs from this file.
